question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 3% per month in 5 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate the **Total Interest Percentage** for the given period.

Total Interest % = **Rate per month** × **Number of months** = 3% × 5 = 15%

Simple Interest (SI) = 15% of ₹1,200

SI = 1200 × 15/100 = 12 × 15 = 180

**∴ The correct answer is ₹180.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹1,200

**Interest Rate (R)** = 3% per month

**Time (T)** = 5 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e8ae2dd7fe1e3f4000c4ec2b493571a3f8ba6125db1ce401fab08dbc4c2560.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (1200 × 3 × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 1200 × 15 ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 12 × 15

⇒ SI = 180

**∴ The correct answer is ₹180.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

The total **Amount (A)** accumulated is the sum of Principal and Interest: A = P + SI.

Consistency of Units

Ensure the **Interest Rate (R)** and **Time (T)** are in the same time units (both in months or both in years). If Rate is annual and Time is in months, divide Time by 12.

Simple Interest Nature

In **Simple Interest**, the interest is always calculated only on the original **Principal** amount, making the interest earned every month constant.
